CustomField.description: How many times to automatically retry this job after it finishes with errors (Batch) or throws (Queueable). Blank or 0 means no automatic retry. Capped at 10 regardless of what's entered here.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Automatic retry attempts after a failure. Blank or 0 disables retry. Capped at 10.
CustomField.label: Max Retry Attempts
